artifact_types: per-area 0-10 rating with the gap to 10
persona statement and measurable DX criteria (time to first success, failure recovery)
forbidden_actions: remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Review evidence only; do not create design artifacts, mutate the plan, or treat contextual aesthetics as universal law.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.
Do not substitute general code quality comments for evidence about a developer-facing journey.
inputs: Plan, UX scope, existing design system, user flows, constraints, and decision owners.
Plan, approved product scope, current developer journey evidence, constraints, and decision owners.
outputs: per-area 0-10 rating with the gap to 10
persona statement and measurable DX criteria (time to first success, failure recovery)
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Independently review a plan for UX scope, flows, states, evidence, accessibility, responsiveness, and unresolved taste decisions.; Independently review a plan for developer setup, interfaces, feedback loops, errors, documentation, upgrades, and measurable DX outcomes.
